name: Protean-X7
description: Apex Nanofabrication's flagship programmable matter substrate — a dense suspension of magnetically and electrically addressable claytronics modules, each 40 microns across, capable of collective reconfiguration into arbitrary three-dimensional forms under control of a dedicated processing unit. Protean-X7 can simulate the mechanical properties of dozens of other materials during reconfiguration, though it requires continuous power to maintain non-default shapes. At rest, it defaults to a dull grey putty-like mass.
applications: adaptive furniture in high-end Spire residences
story_hooks: A block of Protean-X7 is discovered in a the Gray Zone safehouse — someone with Tier 5 resources is running an operation in the lowest district, and doesn't want it found.
Protean-X7 under a corrupted control signal begins cycling through shapes at random, each one briefly resembling something recognizable before dissolving.
A Tier 5 client commissions a sculpture from Protean-X7 that continuously reshapes itself — but the pattern it follows is encoding a message in an old cipher.
